changes.text: In 2022, the company began a process to align segments with its 2040 Strategy business lines, expected to continue throughout 2026, including potential separation of energies for transition business.
changes.evidence: we started a process in 2022 to align our current segments more closely to the business lines set forth in the 2040 Strategy for the Ecopetrol Group, and such process is expected to continue throughout 2026.

changes.text: The energies for transition business line is not yet presented as a separate reportable segment but is managed with dedicated internal financial information.
